With qwen3.8:27b, turning it off answers in 7 to 8 s instead of 12, with no measured loss. The other AI tasks never think.

ai_models_settings_note: Choosing a model also sets its temperature ({temp}) and context ({ctx}). Measured on a 24 GB graphics card; without a graphics card, expect several times longer.
ai_models_study_method: 16 models tested on 6 November 2026 on OmniBank's tasks, each task run twice, temperature 0.2, 32K context, RTX 3090 graphics card. The score out of 10 measures quality only: advisor 40% (12 questions on a demo profile: right tools, exact figures, nothing made up), real statement 30% (category of 120 real labels), labels 15% (45 made-up labels), envelopes 15% (22 categories to place). Speed and memory do not count in it.
ai_models_study_rule_excluded: Not chosen: fewer than 9 right answers out of 12 from the advisor, or a task under half its score, in either of the two runs. The task at fault is shown under the name and in red in its column.
ai_models_study_rule_tiers: Top quality: the best score among models that answer in under 20 s. Alternative: the best score with no time limit. Minimum and Recommended: the models advised for small and medium cards, below.
ai_models_study_rule_tie: Within 0.3 points, the lighter model wins: two runs cannot tell models apart more finely. That is why gemma4:e4b (4.9 GB) comes before mimo-v2.6:9b (7.0 GB) on an 8 GB card.
ai_models_study_legend: Memory: used on the graphics card once the model is loaded, measured with nvidia-smi; Ollama's default version (quantisation shown when known), 32K context, 8-bit context cache (q8_0) with flash attention. With Ollama's default cache (16-bit), allow up to 0.5 GB more. Answer: the advisor's median time.
ai_models_study_cards_note: A model fits a card if its memory is at most the card's size minus 1 GB. A model that is too big still works, partly in system memory, but much more slowly.
ai_models_study_set_ctx: {ctx} context: the advisor's instructions and tools already take about 9,000 tokens. 16K is the minimum accepted; {ctx} leaves room for the conversation history and large imports.
ai_models_study_set_temp: Temperature {temp}: the benchmark value. It only sets the advisor and budget suggestions; categorisation and import always stay at 0.1.
ai_models_study_set_think: Thinking kept for the advisor (benchmark of 8 November 2026): without it, gemma4:e4b stops calling its tools and drops from 9 to 2 or 3 right answers out of 12, and bonsai-2:27b loses up to two. qwen3.8:27b loses nothing and answers in 7 to 8 s instead of 12: the switch in the advanced settings turns it off. pin_info_html:
What the PIN protects: without it, the app and the server refuse access to this profile's data, on every device. After 5 wrong attempts, you must wait 5 minutes.
Recovery code: shown only once for each new PIN. Write it down: it resets a forgotten PIN and lets you restore this profile on another machine.
Limit: the PIN protects access through the app, not the files on the server's disk.
backup_global_info_html: 🔐 PIN-protected profiles are encrypted in the global backup: it can be made even while they are locked. Restoring them requires their PIN (on this server) or their recovery code (on another machine). A profile whose code is not provided is skipped and its current data is kept.
